chapter_title: Concerning the Advent of Five Fathers from the Fiv

fills.notes: The sequence lists the five emanated hypostases (the “five fathers” in ¶3). In the oldest cosmological register this first is the emissary/manifestation proceeding from Mind; Coptic/Greek usage regularly renders it as “Ambassador.”
Fixed by the parallelism of the five clauses: each hypostasis “came” (proceeded) from a distinct interior faculty of the Father.

Correspondential series of interior principles: mind → thought → insight → counsel → consideration. Each is a distinct discrete degree/source for a distinct advent; “thought” is required here to preserve the fivefold mapping.

In the Kephalaia this name often overlays an older function-title (the revealer/beloved proceeding from counsel). Here the structure demands the fourth of the five advents; the transmitted core has retained the label “Jesus the Beloved,” which fits the fivefold scheme without introducing later exhortation.
Mid-word restoration to complete “Lig[ht f]rom” → “Light from,” matching the repeated “from his …” pattern and keeping the procession formula intact.
Completes “summone[d these five] fathers,” the required transition naming the group as five and preparing the identification of their advents.
These five advents correspond to the “five limbs” as discrete powers/regions belonging to the Father of Greatness; “of the Father” is demanded by the emanation logic and the possessive mapping in ¶2.

assessment: All lacunae are tightly constrained by the fivefold correspondential scheme (five interior faculties → five advents → five limbs). Only ¶2 #4 retains an inherited Manichaean/Christianized label (“Jesus”); functionally it remains the fourth emanation from Counsel, so the restoration is still secure at the structural level.
